title: QA run · integration-system (17/20) · ba4afcc2 · 2026-10-19 · 17 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 3 NOT-RUN
body:
Round 2 of the 18.0 release sweep for `integration-system`: re-judges on `ba4afcc2` the clauses round 1 (#24575, subject `5b14b7f3`) left unjudged and that this environment can drive (A class); every other verdict is carried forward from #24575 below. Supersedes #24575 under checklist-test SKILL §5. Wave anchor: #24579.

## Environment fingerprint
- framework `ba4afcc2391922a86678bf5e47b1a0e4d2c87ff1` (pinned; one commit after round 1's `5b14b7f3`, a release-script fix — `git diff 5b14b7f3 ba4afcc2 -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/` is empty, so every item revision is unchanged and carried verdicts stay revision-valid)
- console `.objectui-sha` `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`, built with `pnpm objectui:build` (deps `--concurrency=2`); `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` stamp equals the pin
- app: showcase, canonical boot `OS_PORT=PORT pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa2/LABEL/ITEM.db`; own port + file DB per runner/item; scratch app copies for metadata-writing items; seed `--seed-admin` + showcase seed
- browser: Playwright, `executablePath /opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, one context per runner, form sign-in
- timestamps 2026-10-19: environment prep 14:12–14:44 UTC (cold tree: install 39 s, `pnpm build` 10m20s, console build ~25 min); testing 14:35–14:55 UTC (API legs) and 15:45–15:55 UTC (browser item)
- execution: one API runner sub-agent on :47521/:47522 with a local Postgres 16 on 127.0.0.1:55432 (the #24575 recipe) and a local HTTP echo upstream; one browser runner sub-agent on :47571 for `external-schema-browser-ui`

## Scope
- selector `integration-system` — 20 items (resolver-runnable set; planned/blocked items as in #24575). Revisions per item are those recorded in #24575 (unchanged at ba4afcc2).
- Re-judged this round (A class):
  - `integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle` — acceptance[0]–[6], [8], negative[0]–[5] (live-mount half, Postgres + sqlite)
  - `integration-system.external-schema-introspection` — acceptance[0], [2], [4], negative[0]–[3] (live half)
  - `integration-system.external-schema-drift-gate` — acceptance[0], negative[0] (live boot-abort arm)
  - `integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application` — acceptance[3], [4], negative[0], [1] (live leg)
  - `integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery` — acceptance[3] (501 half — round 1 blocked(fixture); recipe found: `objectstack dev --preset minimal` on a scratch app-todo copy with requires automation, triggers, auth)
  - `integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui` — every clause — round 1 NOT-RUN (Tier 1 pin covers no full clause); driven by hand (RUNNER option (a)), acceptance[6] also on its objectui pin at 4016370a (option (b))

## Round-2 per-clause verdicts (ba4afcc2)
Each line: item revN · clause · verdict · text oracle evidence.

### integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[0] · pass · admin GET /datasources/drivers → 200 with memory/sqlite/postgres/mysql/mongodb, each carrying a configSchema (sqlite: filename, autoMigrate; postgres: url, host, port, database, username, password, ssl, schema); anonymous request to the same route → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[1] · pass · all 11 routes were probed anonymously and each answered 401 UNAUTHENTICATED (GET /, GET /drivers, GET /:name, GET /:name/remote-tables, POST /, POST /test, POST /:name/test, POST /:name/migrate-credential, POST /:name/object-draft, PATCH /:name, DELETE /:name). The same 11 routes as nocap answered 403 PERMISSION_DENIED "Managing datasources requires the `manage_platform_settings` capability." (DELETE of a nonexistent name was refused before resolution as well).
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[2] · pass · POST /datasources/test with an unsaved sqlite draft plus a secret → 200 {ok:true, serverVersion 3.53.4}. The same probe on a Postgres draft → ok:true (PostgreSQL 16.15); with a wrong secret → ok:false "password authentication failed for user "qa"". The list before and after was [default, showcase_external], unchanged. GET /datasources/test → 404 "Datasource "test" does not exist." (the GET :name spelling); no row was persisted under the name "test".
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[3] · pass · On the clean qa_ds_probe and qa_pg, migrate-credential → 200 {status:'already-bound'}. On code-defined showcase_external/default → 200 {status:'refused', reason, remedy}. For the live bind arm I planted a legacy runtime row (qa_pg_legacy, config.password inline, no credentialsRef) directly in sys_metadata and restarted. Before migrating, the detail showed hasSecret:false, redactedConfigKeys:["password"], and /test returned ok:true. migrate-credential → 200 {status:'migrated', migratedKey:'password'}. Afterwards the detail showed hasSecret:true, redactedConfigKeys:[], and /test was still ok:true. The stored metadata now holds external.credentialsRef and no password, and no live DB row contains the value. A re-run → 'already-bound'.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[4] · pass · POST /datasources sqlite-file draft qa_ds_probe → 201 {origin:'runtime', status:'ok'} (a Postgres qa_pg was also created → 201). The list shows both with origin 'runtime' and status 'ok'. The health field is spelled `status`, with `statusReason` when it is in error.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[5] · pass · GET /datasources/qa_ds_probe returns config {filename}, hasSecret:true, and redactedConfigKeys:[]. The secret values (SqliteSecretZ9, QaPgS3cret!) were grepped across the list body, both detail bodies, /meta/datasource, /meta/datasource/qa_pg, /data/sys_metadata?type=datasource and the admin.db file, with 0 hits in each. The stored row carries only external.credentialsRef sys_secret:….
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[6] · pass · Bad drafts each → 400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR: no driver ("A driver is required to create a datasource."), config as a string ("Invalid configuration for driver 'sqlite'. … expected object"), postgres port "abc", the invalid name 'Bad-Name', and the duplicate qa_ds_probe. None returned 500.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · acceptance[8] · pass · GET /datasources/does-not-exist → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND "Datasource "does-not-exist" does not exist.". datasource-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts: 7/7 passed.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · negative[0] · pass · No cleartext secret appeared in any list or detail body (see acceptance[5]; the planted legacy password was never served, before or after migration).
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · negative[1] · pass · Anonymous and no-capability callers got no 200 on any of the 11 routes (22 probes, all 401/403). The drivers 401 is the uniform floor working, not a broken catalog.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · negative[2] · pass · POST /test left no persisted row and did not capture "test" as a name (the list was unchanged).
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · negative[3] · pass · Already-clean rows → 200 already-bound, not 400. After a bind, the inline password is gone from both the read and the stored row.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · negative[4] · pass · No 503 occurs on the wired boot, and none named datasource-admin. Wired remote-tables on qa_ds_probe → 200 {tables:[]}, on qa_pg → 200 widgets/gadgets. The unwired arm comes from the pin: admin-routes.test.ts 30/30 passed this round.
- integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle rev3 · negative[5] · pass · Admin refusals carry DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR, including migrate-credential on an unknown name → 400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR. Introspection refusals carry EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR (object-draft missing table, unknown table, unknown datasource). No cross-attribution was observed.

### integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3
- integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3 · acceptance[0] · pass · GET /datasources/showcase_external/remote-tables → 200 {tables:[{customers, columnCount 7}, {orders, columnCount 7}]}. The draft's fields confirm the 7 columns: id, created_at, updated_at, name, email, region, lifetime_value.
- integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3 · acceptance[2] · pass · POST object-draft {table:'customers'} and the twin POST …/external/tables/customers/draft {} → 200, and the two drafts are deep-equal. definition = {name showcase_customers, label, datasource, external.remoteName 'customers', fields each {type} only}; no field carries primaryKey. The source's first line is exactly "// Generated by `os datasource introspect` (ADR-0015). Review before committing." It contains a value import `import { ObjectSchema } from '@objectstack/spec/data';`, `ObjectSchema.create({`, and the line `// Remote primary key: id`. review = [] (an empty array is allowed). A scratch `tsc --noEmit` (strict, NodeNext) of draft.source exits 0; a negative control with an extra bogus key fails TS2322.
- integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3 · acceptance[4] · pass · Anonymous requests → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED on remote-tables, object-draft, external/tables and external/tables/customers/draft. nocap → 403 PERMISSION_DENIED on all four. The admin spelling says "Managing datasources requires the `manage_platform_settings` capability."; the federation spelling says "Introspecting an external datasource requires the `manage_platform_settings` capability.". Same status and code on both spellings; admin → 200 on both. Twin pin remote-tables-twin.equivalence.test.ts: 10/10 passed.
- integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3 · negative[0] · pass · Introspection refusals all carry EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR: unknown datasource ("has no registered driver to introspect"), unknown table ("Remote table 'nope_tbl' not found …"), and missing body.table. No 503 occurred.
- integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3 · negative[1] · pass · No anonymous 200 on either spelling (all 401).
- integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3 · negative[2] · pass · POST /showcase_external/object-draft {} → 400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR "Body field "table" is required.", not 500.
- integration-system.external-schema-introspection rev3 · negative[3] · pass · ?schema=main, ?schema=, ?schema=a&schema=b, ?schema[]=x and ?schema=%00 → 200 with the full set on both spellings; the same holds for Postgres qa_pg with ?schema=public, ?schema=sales and ?schema=public&schema=sales. No 500 anywhere.

### integration-system.external-schema-drift-gate rev2
- integration-system.external-schema-drift-gate rev2 · acceptance[0] · pass · Scratch copy: ExternalCustomer gained `qa_drift_col: Field.text` (no remote column, a measured missing_column), and showcase_external's validation became `{ checkOnBoot: true }` with onMismatch OMITTED. The boot aborted, exit 1, nothing listening on 47522: "✗ Object 'showcase_ext_customer' does not match its remote table on datasource 'showcase_external':" / "✗ missing_column: customers.qa_drift_col", then "Bootstrap failed after plugins started — rolling back". Reproduced with explicit onMismatch:'fail' under --log-level debug: same two lines, exit 1. ExternalSchemaMismatchError is the only thrower of that message (external-validation-plugin.ts:368). Control: the same scratch copy, in sync (drift column removed) and still with onMismatch omitted, booted to /health 200.

### integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application rev1
- integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application rev1 · acceptance[3] · pass · `objectstack build` of a scratch instance with auth {type:'oauth2', credentialRef} → exit 2, invalid_union at auth.type "Invalid discriminator value. Expected 'none' | 'bearer' | 'api-key' | 'basic'". A build of an entry with inline authentication {type:'api-key', key:'x'} → exit 2 "✗ connectors.9.authentication: Connector 'qa_inline_auth' must not inline secrets via `authentication` — a published connector row is stored whole in `sys_metadata` … references its credential with `auth: { type, credentialRef }` (ADR-0097 §3)." The runtime publish door refuses both the same way: PUT /meta/connector/… → INVALID_METADATA with the same messages; the oauth2 one is HTTP 422.
- integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application rev1 · acceptance[4] · pass · Live boot with QA_BEARER_TOK, QA_BASIC_PW and QA_API_KEY exported; the five instances were state 'ready'. Each was dispatched through a runtime flow (POST /automation, then POST /automation/:name/trigger), and the echo upstream received exactly the expected shape: `Authorization: Bearer TOK`; `Basic cWE6…` (= qa:PW); `x-api-key: KEY`; `?api_key=KEY` with no key header; and nothing at all for none. The three secret values and the base64 basic credential were grepped across GET /automation/connectors, /meta/connector (list), /meta/connector/EACH-OF-5, /meta, /automation/actions, /data/sys_metadata?type=connector, runs and run detail, and the server log, with 0 hits. Positive control: the echo capture file does contain them. The /meta reads show only credentialRef names, plus username "qa" on basic.
- integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application rev1 · negative[0] · pass · No resolved secret appeared in any listing, meta or descriptor body (see acceptance[4]).
- integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application rev1 · negative[1] · pass · The oauth2 entry did not build clean (exit 2), and inline non-'none' authentication neither built nor published (build exit 2; PUT /meta → INVALID_METADATA).

### integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery rev4
- integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery rev4 · acceptance[3] · pass · Supported host without MessagingServicePlugin: `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --preset minimal` on a scratch app-todo copy whose requires is ['automation','triggers','auth']. Its boot plugin list (32) has no MessagingServicePlugin. Results: anonymous GET /api/v1/notifications → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; authenticated admin (get-session confirmed) GET /notifications → 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED "Install @objectstack/service-messaging to enable"; POST /notifications/read and /read/all → the same 501. Discovery reports notification {enabled:false, status:'unavailable'}. No empty inbox was fabricated. Both halves now hold, so the clause passes. Stock app-todo with `--preset minimal` alone refuses to boot ("This stack mounts no auth …"), which is why the copy adds 'auth'.

The table rows are "customers 7" and "orders 7", which equals the API listing name for name and count for count. Rows (est.) shows "—" because the listing has no estimate. The server then answered ok:false with 4 results, one of them missing_column customers.qa_drift_col. The panel rendered "1 of 4 objects diverge from the remote schema.", 4 rows, and "showcase_customers · 1 diff · MISSING COLUMN customers.qa_drift_col". Every rendered diff carries its label; only the missing_column kind was induced.
- integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui rev3 · acceptance[5] · pass · The identity was proven with get-session (qa.nocap@example.com, created by admin create-user and with its password changed; not an org member).

## Product defects (extraction)
Low-severity observations, not extracted (no clause fails on them; session card cap) — for the lane owning `service-external-datasource` / `service-datasource`, listed here so they are not lost:
- (Low, observation) The external-datasource `?schema=` filter (external-datasource-service.ts listRemoteTables: skip only when `tableSchema && tableSchema !== opts.schema`) can never narrow on the in-tree SQL driver. Neither the SQLite nor the Postgres introspection emits schema-qualified names, so on real Postgres `?schema=sales` returns the public tables and never the sales tables. That is a silently wrong answer rather than a refusal. The pinned twin test passes only because its fake returns qualified names. Repro: a Postgres datasource with tables in public and sales → GET /api/v1/datasources/PG/remote-tables?schema=sales → 200 [widgets, gadgets] (public), expected [invoices] or an explicit "schema filter not supported" refusal.
- (Low, observation) POST /api/v1/datasources with `driver: 'nosuchdriver'` → 201, and the row is persisted with status 'error' "no driver factory supports driver 'nosuchdriver'". The draft validation does not refuse an unknown driver id, although the drivers catalog is closed. This may be intentional, for plugin-supplied drivers such as turso.
- (Info) After planting and migrating, the raw admin.db file still contained one byte-level occurrence of the planted legacy password in free page space. No live row holds it and no route serves it, and the residue may come from my out-of-band plant rather than the product. Not scored.
- external-schema-browser-ui: a second `POST …/external/tables/orders/import` for an existing object answers 201 again and overwrites it (no clause covers it; not scored).

## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps
For the wave anchor #24579 (not extracted).
- notify-inbox-delivery knownGaps[2] is STALE.
